items.exampleEn: The architect showed us a model of the new school.
items.exampleZh: 建築師給我們看新學校的模型。

items.exampleEn: Please ride your bike on the road, not on the sidewalk.
items.exampleZh: 請在馬路上騎腳踏車，不要騎在人行道上。

items.exampleEn: Many tourists take photos in front of the old monument.
items.exampleZh: 很多觀光客在那座古老的紀念碑前拍照。

items.exampleEn: Children threw coins into the fountain and made a wish.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們把硬幣丟進噴水池許願。

items.exampleEn: The firefighters saved a cat from the roof.
items.exampleZh: 消防員把一隻貓從屋頂上救下來。

items.exampleEn: She teaches at an art institute.
items.exampleZh: 她在一所藝術學院教書。

items.exampleEn: It rains a lot in this region.

items.exampleZh: 南部的城市通常比較溫暖。

items.sentenceEn: My cousin wants to be a firefighter.

items.audioEn: Meet me at the fountain in the town square at three.
items.audioZh: 三點在鎮上廣場的噴水池跟我碰面。

items.sentenceEn: The sidewalk was wet after the rain.
The institute offers language classes at night.
items.sentenceZh: 這所學院晚上開設語言課程。

items.stemEn: This bridge was designed by a famous ____.
items.stemZh: 這座橋是一位知名建築師設計的。

items.stemEn: The company now sells its products ____, in more than thirty countries.
items.stemZh: 這家公司現在把產品銷往國際，超過三十個國家。

items.passageEn: Welcome to Riverton, a small town in the southern region of the country. In the old square, you can see a stone monument and a large fountain. A famous architect designed the town hall, and people now come from other countries to see it. Next to it is a science institute that welcomes visitors on weekends. Delivery vans can't enter the square before 10 a.m. Every spring, the town's firefighters show their trucks to children.
items.passageZh: 歡迎來到 Riverton，這是位於該國南部地區的一座小鎮。在古老的廣場上，你可以看到一座石造紀念碑和一座大噴水池。一位知名建築師設計了市政廳，如今有人從其他國家專程來看。市政廳旁邊有一所科學研究機構，週末開放參觀。上午 10 點以前，送貨廂型車不能進入廣場。每年春天，鎮上的消防員會向孩子們展示他們的消防車。

questions.questionZh: 送貨廂型車什麼時候以前不能進入廣場？

referenceEn: This region is famous for its fruit.
The region is well known for its fruit.
rubricZh: region 表示「地區」，可數名詞
「以……聞名」可寫，例如 be famous for、be known for 等
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.promptZh: 南部的口音和北部的不太一樣。
referenceEn: The southern accent is a bit different from the northern one.
The southern accent is not quite the same as the northern accent.
rubricZh: 用 southern 表示「南部的」（例如 the southern accent）
「不太一樣」可寫，例如 a bit different from、not quite the same as 等
